notes: New: after every build there's a "How to play this build" section (which attacks to use and in what order, how fast your mana lets you cast, which buffs the numbers count and how to keep them up, your powder special), and the bot sums it up in chat. New: an "In Wynnbuilder" section that says what Wynnbuilder will show when you open the link (it starts with every toggle off) and why the app's numbers can differ, so the bot can answer those questions; paste your own link and it does the same for your build. Crafted-item searches are a bit faster (same builds).
